name: Sodium palmitoyl sarcosinate
description: Sodium palmitoyl sarcosinate (CAS 4028-10-8 ), also marketed as Sarcosinate PN, is a mild fatty acid-derived surfactant built on a sarcosine backbone. It delivers cleansing, foaming, and emulsification performance across personal care and industrial formulations. This chemical is highly valued where skin compatibility and low irritation potential are commercial priorities. In rinse-off personal care products like shampoos and facial cleansers, it functions as a primary or co-surfactant. It generates stable foam while reducing the harshness of sulfate-based systems in body washes. Toothpaste and oral care formulations use it as a cleansing and foaming agent compatible with active ingredients such as fluoride. In home care and industrial cleaning compounds, it contributes degreasing and emulsification performance. It is frequently utilized in liquid detergents and hard-surface cleaners to improve overall cleaning efficiency. Textile and leather processing operations use it as a processing aid where controlled foaming is required. Its surface-active behavior remains effective at various pH levels, making it versatile for diverse manufacturing environments. Sodium palmitoyl sarcosinate is typically supplied as a white to off-white powder or as an aqueous solution. Technical and cosmetic grades are the most commonly available options for industrial procurement. Cosmetic-grade material meets purity specifications relevant to personal care manufacturing standards.
